answer.question: The outage is resolved. Show me the post-incident review and how we prevent the next one.
answer.answer:
Good news — full restoration in 87 minutes, beating every target (8-min response, 100% first-time fix), protecting ~$37.9K in revenue at a 785% ROI.

**Prevention plan:**
- **Now (30 days):** Wildlife mitigation at Substation 7B ($8,400) + expanded vegetation management ($12,200/yr) — cuts recurrence risk ~78%
- **Longer term:** IoT sensors on 6 critical feeders ($28,500, gives 15–30 min early warning), smart grid automation ($340K, pays back in 4.6 months)

Draft work orders are ready: **WO-2847** (wildlife mitigation, Crew E-7), **WO-2848** (vegetation, contractor), **WO-2849** (IoT sensors, engineering) — none created yet, just staged for your approval.

Monthly ops are trending well too: response time down to 8 min (from 14), first-time fix up to 96%, ~$29K/month saved via route optimization.

Want me to pull up the full crew route details for any of these follow-up jobs?
